The poster features a close-up of Pennywise the Clown, the iconic antagonist from the story, with his menacing face and red balloon prominently displayed. The background is dark and ominous, enhancing the horror theme. The text on the poster reads: "HBO ORIGINAL" "WELCOME TO DERRY" "WELCOME TO DERRY IS AMAZING.
